title.ja: 図1-1 ゴキゲン中飛車の基本図
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic diagram of Gokigen Central Rook

explain.ja: 図1-1はゴキゲン中飛車の基本図です。ゴキゲン中飛車は基本的に後手番で使う戦法なので、後手の立場から解説し、盤面を反転しています。基本形までの指し手や変化は別の記事で解説しています。
explain.en: This first diagram is the basic Gokigen Central Rook position. Since the opening is normally played as White, it is explained from White's side and the board is flipped. The moves and variations leading to the basic form are covered in another article.

section.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車の基本形
section.en: Basic form of Gokigen Central Rook

title.ja: 図1-2 片美濃囲いに組むのが基本
title.en: Figure 1-2: Building Single Mino is basic

explain.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車側は、まず片美濃囲いを組むのが基本です。中飛車では5二に飛車がいて左の金を美濃囲いに寄せられないため、いったんこれで囲いは完成です。左の金は、△3二金として相手の飛車の攻めを守るのに使うこともあれば、△5一金と強引に囲いに寄せる手もあります。
explain.en: The Central Rook side basically begins by building the half Mino castle. With the rook on 5二, the left gold cannot join the Mino castle, so for now the castle is complete. The left gold can be used for defense against the opponent's rook with △3二金, or forced toward the castle with △5一金.

line.text: ▲7八玉、△6二玉、▲5八金右、△7二玉、▲3六歩、△8二玉、▲9六歩、△9四歩、▲3七銀、△7二銀

title.ja: 図1-3 銀を中央に使っていく
title.en: Figure 1-3: Use the silver in the center

explain.ja: 囲いができたら、次は攻めの形を作ります。銀を中央に使うのがゴキゲン中飛車の基本の形で、ここから飛車と銀で攻めていきます。
explain.en: Once the castle is built, the next step is to build the attacking formation. Using the silver in the center is the basic shape of Gokigen Central Rook, and from here you attack with the rook and silver.

section.ja: 銀を中央に繰り出していく
section.en: Bring the silver out to the center

line.text: ▲6八銀、△4二銀、▲1六歩、△5三銀、▲1五歩、△5四銀

title.ja: 図2-1 銀をさらに前に出す

explain.ja: 中央を攻めるため、さらに銀を前に出しました。これで5六の地点に駒の利きが増えます。
explain.en: To attack in the center, the silver is advanced further, which adds support to the 5六 square.

section.en: Aim to break through the center

title.ja: 図2-2 中央から仕掛ける

explain.ja: いよいよ5筋から仕掛けます。まず△5六歩と5筋の歩を突き捨てます。ここで△7六銀と歩を取りに行く手も有力です。
explain.en: Now the attack on the fifth file begins. First sacrifice the fifth-file pawn with △5六歩. Capturing the pawn with △7六銀 is also a good option here.

section.en: Aim to break through the center

explain.ja: 図2-2からは△5六銀と攻めたいところですが、まず角を交換します。ゴキゲン中飛車は5筋の歩を突いた時点で自分の角道が開くので、角を交換して持ち駒にすれば攻め駒を増やせます。また▲同玉と角を取らせることで、相手の守りの陣形を乱せるのもポイントです。
explain.en: From this position you would like to attack with △5六銀, but first exchange bishops. In Gokigen Central Rook your bishop line opens once the fifth-file pawn is pushed, so exchanging bishops gives you a bishop in hand and more attacking pieces. Forcing the opponent to recapture with ▲同玉 also disrupts their defensive formation.

section.ja: 角を交換して持ち駒にしよう!
section.en: Exchange bishops and make it a piece in hand!

title.ja: 図2-4 これで攻めがないようだが…？
title.en: Figure 2-4: It seems there is no attack, but...?

explain.ja: 角を交換したら、△5六銀から攻めます。相手に▲5七歩と打たれると攻めが続かないように見えますが、ここで先ほど取った角を使う手筋があります。
explain.en: After the bishop exchange, attack with △5六銀. It may look like the attack stalls if the opponent drops a pawn with ▲5七歩, but there is a tesuji using the bishop you just captured.

section.ja: 角を交換して持ち駒にしよう!
section.en: Exchange bishops and make it a piece in hand!

title.ja: 図2-5 飛車取りに当てながら攻め駒を足す
title.en: Figure 2-5: Attack while adding pieces and hitting the rook

explain.ja: ここは△3九角と打つのが好手です。飛車取りに当てながら、5七の地点に攻め駒を足せます。相手が▲5六歩と銀を取っても、△2八角成で飛車が取れます。
explain.en: Dropping the bishop with △3九角 is the good move here. It attacks the rook while adding an attacking piece toward 5七. Even if the opponent captures the silver with ▲5六歩, △2八角成 wins the rook.

section.ja: 中央に駒を足す角打ち
section.en: A bishop drop that adds a piece to the center

title.ja: 図2-6 これでゴキゲン中飛車が勝勢
title.en: Figure 2-6: Now Gokigen Central Rook is winning

explain.ja: 相手が飛車を逃がしたら、△5七銀成と攻めて後手勝勢です。次に▲3九飛と角を取れば△5八成銀と攻めが続き、角を取らず▲5七銀と来れば△同角成で攻めが続きます。これで相手の陣形はボロボロです。
explain.en: Once the opponent moves the rook away, △5七銀成 puts White in a winning position. If Black then captures the bishop with ▲3九飛, the attack continues with △5八成銀, and if Black instead plays ▲5七銀 without taking the bishop, △同角成 keeps the attack going. Black's formation is in tatters.

section.ja: 中央に駒を足す角打ち
section.en: A bishop drop that adds a piece to the center
